description: Screen templates for the image-driven YouTube Studio uploader (YOUTUBE_UPLOAD_METHOD=studio). Capture each one on the machine that uploads with: python3 scripts/python/youtube_studio_vision_uploader.py --calibrate. Images are screen-, theme-, zoom- and language-specific, so they live in config/studio_templates/<profile>/ and are never committed.

dashboard_ready.hint: Something only visible when YouTube Studio is loaded and signed in, e.g. the 'Channel dashboard' heading or the Studio logo.

channel_badge.hint: Your channel's avatar or name as Studio shows it. When captured, every upload first checks the browser is signed into THIS channel.

create_button.hint: The CREATE button (camera icon) in the Studio top bar.

upload_videos_item.hint: 'Upload videos' in the menu that opens under CREATE.

select_files_button.hint: The SELECT FILES button in the upload dialog.

details_title_field.hint: The 'Title (required)' box on the Details step. Put the click point inside the text area.

details_description_field.hint: The 'Description' box on the Details step. Put the click point inside the text area.

not_made_for_kids_radio.hint: The 'No, it's not made for kids' radio (scroll the Details step so it is visible while capturing).

made_for_kids_radio.hint: The 'Yes, it's made for kids' radio. Only needed for jobs that set madeForKids.

show_more_button.hint: SHOW MORE at the bottom of the Details step. Needed only to fill tags.

tags_field.hint: The 'Add tag' box revealed by SHOW MORE.

next_button.hint: The NEXT button at the bottom right of the upload dialog.

visibility_step_marker.hint: The 'Visibility' step heading, or the 'Save or publish' panel title.

private_radio.hint: The 'Private' radio on the Visibility step.

unlisted_radio.hint: The 'Unlisted' radio. Needed for jobs set to unlisted.

public_radio.hint: The 'Public' radio. Needed for jobs set to public.

copy_link_button.hint: The copy icon next to 'Video link' in the right-hand panel. The uploader reads the link from the clipboard.

upload_complete_marker.hint: The bottom-bar status once the file has finished uploading, e.g. 'Checks complete' or 'Upload complete'. The tab is not closed before this appears.

save_button.hint: The SAVE button (shown for Private). Capture a Public upload's PUBLISH button as publish_button.

publish_button.hint: The PUBLISH button shown for Unlisted/Public.

finished_dialog_marker.hint: The confirmation shown after SAVE/PUBLISH, e.g. 'Video saved as private' or 'Video published'.

signed_out_marker.hint: The Google 'Sign in' page or button. When seen, the uploader pauses and waits for a person to sign in.

challenge_marker.hint: A Google verification or CAPTCHA prompt. When seen, the uploader pauses and waits for a person.

upload_limit_marker.hint: The 'Daily upload limit reached' notice. When seen before a file is selected, the job defers to tomorrow.
